items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Both requested variants exist: boolean default:true opens pre-checked (validator accepts, modal seeds via initialBooleanValue) and slash_command accepts fixed plain flags. boolean+required stays rejected as the screenshots demand.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Invalid slash_command and boolean+required still fail loudly at upload/load with typed codes; no new runtime failure paths.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: SLASH_COMMAND_PATTERN stays a strict allowlist (token + -x/--long[=value] flags only); shell metacharacters, quotes, spaces in values rejected and tested; value is still q()-escaped by the substituter.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Validator accept/reject cases, pure initialBooleanValue + explicitParamEntries round trip (checked -> forwarded, unchecked -> dropped), and a real-browser E2E (pre-checked box, uncheck, metachar upload 400).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No loops over data or I/O added; one regex and one O(n) schema pass.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New test moved to its own file and the pattern comment shortened to stay under the bloat-baseline ceilings (actions-schema-validator.test.ts untouched, actions-substitute.ts 645 <= 646).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: actions.json (user-edited) -> validator -> GET /actions -> modal init -> explicitParamEntries -> launch payload; the server never auto-applies an optional default, so unchecking emits no flag. Round trip covered by the E2E upload + dialog.
